# Viewpoint For Projects (VFP)

- **Product:** Viewpoint For Projects (VFP) (Construction software family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 authorization code via identity-uk.team.viewpoint.com (scope vfp.fullaccess). Declared security schemes: oauth2.
- **Access:** Viewpoint For Projects customers.
- **To call it you would need:** a VFP OAuth client registered with Viewpoint and the customer's regional API host (api-uk.vfp.viewpoint.com is the documented one).
- **Documented servers:** `https://api-uk.vfp.viewpoint.com`.
- **Definition:** [viewpoint-for-projects](https://api-uk.vfp.viewpoint.com/swagger/docs/latest) (Viewpoint for Projects - API, version latest). Documentation: https://help.trimble.com/en/viewpoint-for-projects/viewpoint-for-projects/administrators-guide/it-dept-info/api-and-developer-documentation.
